verdict: A top-3 account. The gaps are setup, not power: Conquest beam order, Dungeon exclusions and the PvP deck choice.

items.action: Reset Pinot, Dark Choco and Tiger Lily to Lv.1 before the season
items.why: At Lv.100 their ATK is above Macaron, Tea Knight and Cheesecake, so they take the buffers' beams.
items.payoff: Beams 4–6 go back to the buffers, as in the deck behind the record's 1T 999G.
items.cost: Free; a reset refunds all EXP. Pinot plays Lv.1 in PvP until re-levelled.

items.action: Lower Scorpion until she's exactly 7th in ATK
items.why: At Lv.100 (2.63M ATK) she's 4th. Her job is only to catch stray beams.
items.payoff: One more beam reaches a buffer.
items.cost: Free, roughly Lv.1–45. The Dungeon wants her high, so re-level her for it.

items.action: Check the ATK order in battle before keeping a run
items.why: The order must be Milk › Brightseeker › Skating Queen › Macaron › Tea Knight › Cheesecake. Octo Wasabi's +8% doesn't show on the stat screen.
items.payoff: Catches misaligned beams before the run is spent.

items.action: Donate gems to finish Light Elemental DMG research 14-2
items.why: It's 49% done, and Light covers Milk, Brightseeker, Cheesecake and Tea Knight. The Piñata is weak to Light.
items.payoff: +10% Elemental DMG for the Conquest carries.

items.action: Reset Cool Mint, Licorice, Cream Soda, Shortcake and Lemon to Lv.1
items.why: Excluded chargers, summoners and projectile cookies in the top 40 pull Milk away from the dealers.
items.payoff: One measurement: benching Oven Wanderer and Cool Mint gave +42%. You score 128G; the meta deck makes 379G.
items.cost: Free; none of them is in your lineups.

items.action: Swap Icy Birdie for King Choco Drop in Rumble defense
items.why: Over 95% of top-100 Rumble teams run King Choco Drop. Yours sits unused at 10★.
items.payoff: +16% max HP for the whole team.

items.action: Put Cherry Cola in Doughnut King's slot in Rumble defense
items.why: The meta slot r2-5 is the third charger. Vampire is the alternative.
items.payoff: Matches 9 of the 12 fully revealed top-100 teams.
items.cost: Free. Re-check once Season 2's buff shows.

items.action: Test Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in a spare Arena attack lineup
items.why: Your Bari is 8★, past the 7★ line where Bari beats Rye at equal spec.
items.payoff: The record's top Arena deck. You're 4th with the Rye deck.

items.action: Spend the banked 31,930 SP on Stellar shuffles
items.why: The area is 86%. Each shuffle can raise ATK/DEF/HP amp, which applies in every mode.
items.payoff: ATK amp above 111.8%. The record's stop lines are 91–95%.
items.cost: 150 SP a shuffle, so about 212 shuffles on hand.

items.action: At the Lv.120 cap, level Milk first and keep her ATK #1
items.why: Every buff order and both ATK perks key off the ATK #1 ally.
items.payoff: A bigger Milk buff in Conquest, the Dungeon, the Rift and PvP.
items.cost: EXP. The 10-08 patch refunds Lv.79–100 EXP, about 10.5M per Lv.100 cookie.

items.action: Then level the PvP twelve to 120
items.why: Level counts in Arena; Resolve, Stellar, the labs and Fame don't.
items.payoff: PvP stats at the new cap.

items.action: Reroll Milk's four SR ATK lines toward SSR ATK
items.why: Her 4.2–4.7 lines could roll 6–7. Milk wants all ATK% in Conquest and the Dungeon.
items.payoff: About +9–11 points of ATK AMP on the cookie every buff scales from.

items.action: Reroll Skating Queen's three low lines to SSR Skill AMP
items.why: Her U DR, C ATK and U HP lines add nothing to her buff, which scales with skill amp.
items.payoff: A stronger skill-amp buff on the beam recipients.

items.action: Upgrade Cheesecake's and Pomegranate's SR/R Skill AMP lines to SSR
items.why: Cheesecake has 2 SR lines plus 2 junk lines; Pomegranate has 3 SR, 1 R and 1 C.
items.payoff: Stronger buffs from the Volley grant and Pomegranate's beams.

items.action: Take Brightseeker to 10★
items.why: 10★ opens two rune slots. The 1.62T run used a 10★ Brightseeker.
items.payoff: More haste or skill amp on the carry; the size of the gain is unmeasured.

items.action: Raise Tea Knight from 5★ to 7★ for skill tier IV
items.why: She's the only buffer under 9★, and her +70% Boss DMG buff fills a beam slot.
items.payoff: Unmeasured.

items.action: Rune Bari for haste and DR; tank Hound, Ion and Oven
items.why: Bari wants about 45 haste; yours runs ATK lines. Hound's runes are offensive.
items.payoff: Full Soul Guidance uptime, and PvP tanks that hold.
items.cost: Rune crystals. Bari's ATK lines also serve the Rift.

items.action: Plate the Conquest top-left weapons toward +20
items.why: Sub-options rise from +130% at +15 to +200% at +20. Yours are +16 to +17.
items.payoff: Bigger skill-amp and crit DMG lines.
items.cost: Chocosteel and Syrup; about 2% a try at 19→20.

items.action: In Rift Season 2, run the levelled-Rye setup
items.why: Non-dealers at Lv.64–70 stack the ATK-ordered buffs on Brightseeker, Rye and Cherry Cola.
items.payoff: The record's furthest 15% clear. You run Bari, Crepe and Moon Rabbit instead.

items.action: Promote Continuum Cog from 0★ (0/1)
items.why: It gives +50% boss DMG in the Rift even at base.
items.payoff: Unmeasured.

items.action: Get Chardonnay and test her as the Volley source
items.why: Her line buff grants Volley and could take over Tiger Lily's sixth-beam role.
items.payoff: Unmeasured; her numbers are datamined only.

items.action: Finish Oven 40
items.why: The gear level cap is Oven × 3, so 117 becomes 120. The mission is 39/40.
items.payoff: Higher base stats on new gear, plus 1,000 gems.

items.action: Reset Bari, Oven and Cherry Cola only for Dungeon sessions
items.why: The Dungeon records exclude them, but they're your PvP core.
items.payoff: Completes the exclusion list.
items.cost: PvP defense is weaker while they sit at Lv.1.

items.action: Re-pick the Rumble deck once the Season 2 buff shows
items.why: Season 1's Charge HP +30% propped up Bari and Oven.
items.payoff: The defense fits the new passive.

items.action: Replace the crit-RES lines on BR2 and BR3 with DR
items.why: Crit resistance does nothing against the Conquest boss.
items.payoff: Small; survival only.

items.action: Take Bari to 9★ through the pickup counter
items.why: The counter is at 3,017 of 3,060, and Bari's strength scales with stars.
items.payoff: More Bari DR and a shorter cooldown.

items.action: Star up King Choco Drop (10★, 1/4)
items.why: It's the top Rumble pet; its HP grant grows with stars.
items.payoff: More team HP in Rumble.

items.action: Fame 132, then the Gnome Lab DEF row
items.why: Fame's crit DMG goes 86→88. Lab DEF is at 5/7.
items.payoff: Small stat gains.
items.cost: 190 Fame medals (52 on hand) and lab stones.

parked.why: GingerCraven never falls at 15%. Idle there for Dimensional Energy; the season ends 10-08.
1.3T coins a level, for power only.
Power isn't damage; rank by damage or score.
About 1 run in 4 misaligns, and it ranks below Cherry.
